title: Contract margin upload (BOW front end, CONTRACT_MARGIN)
purpose: Intraday and delivery margin multipliers per client, exchange, market and segment (100 / leverage: 20 is 5 times, 100 no leverage), from the firm's contract margin lines in Connections → BOW upload files, for each active client with the segment open; new or changed clients since the last file. BOW's file uploader takes it from 17:30 to 08:00.

columns.name: Backoffice Id
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. The client's UCC

columns.name: Exchange
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. BSE, NSE, MCX, NCDEX

columns.name: Market
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. EQUITY, DERIVATIVE, CURRENCY, COMMODITIES

columns.name: Segment
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. EQUITY, FUTURES, OPTIONS, COMMODITIES-FUTURES …

columns.name: Intraday Margin
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. Intraday margin multiplier: 100 / leverage (20 for 5 times)

columns.name: Delivery Margin
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. Delivery margin multiplier: 100 / leverage (100 for none)

linked: Live RMS → Front-office files → BOW uploads (contract margin)
